title: Reports destructions of arrays of polymorphic objects that are destructed as their base class.
summary: If the dynamic type of the array is different from its static type, calling delete[] is undefined. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-cplusplus.ArrayDelete. It applies to C++.

title: Check for inner pointers of C++ containers used after re/deallocation.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-cplusplus.InnerPointer. It applies to C++.

title: Find use-after-move bugs in C++. This includes method calls on moved-from objects, assignment of a moved-from object, and repeated move of a moved-from object.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-cplusplus.Move. It applies to C++.

title: Check for double-free and use-after-free problems.
summary: Traces memory managed by new/delete. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-cplusplus.NewDelete. It applies to C++.

title: Check for memory leaks.
summary: Traces memory managed by new/delete. clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-cplusplus.NewDeleteLeaks. It applies to C++.

title: Check if default placement new is provided with pointers to sufficient storage capacity.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-cplusplus.PlacementNew. It applies to C++.

title: When virtual methods are called during construction and destruction the polymorphism is restricted to the class that's being constructed or destructed because the more derived contexts are either not yet initialized or already destructed.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-cplusplus.PureVirtualCall. It applies to C++.

title: Checks C++ copy and move assignment operators for self assignment.
summary: It applies to C++.

title: Checks std::string operations.
summary: clang-tidy runs it as the check clang-analyzer-cplusplus.StringChecker. It applies to C++.

title: Cppcoreguidelines-avoid-c-arrays redirects here as an alias for this check.
summary: It is an alias of the check modernize-avoid-c-arrays, which does the same work.

title: Flags C++20 coroutine lambdas with non-empty capture lists that may cause use-after-free errors and suggests avoiding captures or ensuring the lambda closure object has a guaranteed lifetime.
summary: The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: This check warns when structs or classes that are copyable or movable, and have const-qualified or reference (lvalue or rvalue) data members.
summary: Having such members is rarely useful, and makes the class only copy-constructible but not copy-assignable. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: Warns when using do-while loops.
summary: They are less readable than plain while loops, since the termination condition is at the end and the condition is not checked prior to the first iteration. This can lead to subtle bugs. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: The usage of goto for control flow is error prone and should be replaced with looping constructs.
summary: Only forward jumps in nested loops are accepted. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: Detects magic numbers, integer or floating point literals that are embedded in code and not introduced via constants or symbols.
summary: It is an alias of the check readability-magic-numbers, which does the same work.

title: Finds non-const global variables as described in I.2 of C++ Core Guidelines.
summary: As R.6 of C++ Core Guidelines is a duplicate of rule I.2 it also covers that rule. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: Warns when a coroutine accepts reference parameters.
summary: After a coroutine suspend point, references could be dangling and no longer valid. Instead, pass parameters as values. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds declarations of assign operators with the wrong return and/or argument types and definitions with good return type but wrong return statements.
summary: It is an alias of the check misc-unconventional-assign-operator, which does the same work.

title: Checks that constructors callable with a single argument and conversion operators are marked explicit to avoid the risk of unintentional implicit conversions.
summary: It is an alias of the check misc-explicit-constructor, which does the same work. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds.

title: Adds override (introduced in C++11) to overridden virtual functions and removes virtual from those functions as it is not required.
summary: It is an alias of the check modernize-use-override, which does the same work. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds.

title: Checks whether there are local variables that are declared without an initial value.
summary: These may lead to unexpected behavior if there is a code path that reads the variable before assigning to it. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: This check flags initializers of globals that access extern objects, and therefore can lead to order-of-initialization problems.
summary: The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: Replaces groups of adjacent macros with an unscoped anonymous enum.
summary: It is an alias of the check modernize-macro-to-enum, which does the same work. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds.

title: Finds macro usage that is considered problematic because better language constructs exist for the task.
summary: The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: Warns when lambda specify a by-value capture default and capture this.
summary: clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: Warns when a forwarding reference parameter is not forwarded inside the function body.
summary: The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: Cppcoreguidelines-narrowing-conversions redirects here as an alias for this check.
summary: It is an alias of the check bugprone-narrowing-conversions, which does the same work.

title: This check handles C-Style memory management using malloc(), realloc(), calloc() and free().
summary: It warns about its use and tries to suggest the use of an appropriate RAII object. Furthermore, it can be configured to check against a user-specified list of functions that are used for memory management (e.g. posix_memalign()). The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: Flags coroutines that suspend while a lock guard is in scope at the suspension point.
summary: The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: The check flags user-defined destructors marked with noexcept(expr) where expr evaluates to false (but is not a false literal itself).
summary: It is an alias of the check performance-noexcept-destructor, which does the same work. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds.

title: The check flags user-defined move constructors and assignment operators not marked with noexcept or marked with noexcept(expr) where expr evaluates to false (but is not a false literal itself).
summary: It is an alias of the check performance-noexcept-move-constructor, which does the same work. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds.

title: The check flags user-defined swap and iter_swap functions not marked with noexcept or marked with noexcept(expr) where expr evaluates to false (but is not a false literal itself).
summary: It is an alias of the check performance-noexcept-swap, which does the same work. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds.

title: Cppcoreguidelines-non-private-member-variables-in-classes redirects here as an alias for this check.
summary: It is an alias of the check misc-non-private-member-variables-in-classes, which does the same work.

title: This check implements the type-based semantics of gsl::owner<T*>, which allows static analysis on code, that uses raw pointers to handle resources like dynamic memory, but won't introduce RAII concepts.
summary: The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds member initializations in the constructor body which can be converted into member initializers of the constructor instead.
summary: This not only improves the readability of the code but also positively affects its performance. Class-member assignments inside a control statement or following the first control statement are ignored. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: This check flags all array to pointer decays.
summary: The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds calls to operator[] in STL containers and suggests replacing them with safe alternatives.
summary: Safe alternatives include STL at or GSL at functions, begin() or end() functions, range-for loops, std::span, or an appropriate function from <algorithms>. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: This check flags all array subscript expressions on static arrays and std::arrays that either do not have a constant integer expression index or are out of bounds (for std::array).
summary: For out-of-bounds checking of static arrays, see the -Warray-bounds Clang diagnostic. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: This check flags all usage of pointer arithmetic, because it could lead to an invalid pointer.
summary: Subtraction of two pointers is not flagged by this check. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: Imposes limitations on the use of const_cast within C++ code.
summary: It depends on the StrictMode option setting to determine whether it should flag all instances of const_cast or only those that remove either const or volatile qualifier. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: This check flags all use of C-style casts that perform a static_cast downcast, const_cast, or reinterpret_cast.
summary: clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: The check flags user-provided constructor definitions that do not initialize all fields that would be left in an undefined state by default construction, e.g. builtins, pointers and record types without user-provided default constructors containing at least one such type.
summary: If these fields aren't initialized, the constructor will leave some of the memory in an undefined state. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: This check flags all uses of reinterpret_cast in C++ code.
summary: The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: This check flags all usages of static_cast, where a base class is casted to a derived class.
summary: In those cases, a fix-it is provided to convert the cast to a dynamic_cast. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: This check flags all access to members of unions.
summary: Passing unions as a whole is not flagged. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: This check flags all calls to c-style vararg functions and all use of va_arg.
summary: The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: Warns when an rvalue reference function parameter is never moved within the function body.
summary: The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: Flags slicing of member variables or vtable.
summary: Slicing happens when copying a derived object into a base object: the members of the derived object (both member variables and virtual member functions) will be discarded. This can be misleading especially for member function slicing. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: The check finds classes where some but not all of the special member functions are defined.
summary: The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: This check converts constructors' member initializers into the new default member initializers in C++11.
summary: It is an alias of the check modernize-use-default-member-init, which does the same work. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds.

title: Finds unscoped (non-class) enum declarations and suggests using enum class instead.
summary: Unnamed enum are ignored and will be handled by check implementing Enum.6. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.

title: Finds virtual classes whose destructor is neither public and virtual nor protected and non-virtual.
summary: A virtual class's destructor should be specified in one of these ways to prevent undefined behavior. clang-tidy can fix the code that it finds. The check is in the cppcoreguidelines module of clang-tidy.
